title: An agent that checks
sub: The ninth film of a series on data governance: governance's rules, written as steps an agent follows on every change. It finds, drafts and flags; people decide. And the agent is governed too.
howto: The film is painted in watercolour, in the university's own rooms. Behind each person, a soft wash of their side: gold for the business side, cyan for the technical side. The agent is a small turning star on a dashed cyan card, never a person. Gold is a person's decision; green runs in the work, grey can go, and red is what nobody owns yet.
